title: One to One Personal Training
introduction: Working with a personal trainer helps you reach your goal faster while teaching you how to independently sustain your results after the process is complete.
audience_content:
This is great for anyone who would like to follow a personalised programme to reach their health and fitness related goal faster.

It is for someone who is unsure where to begin, have tried many times before and failed, or have stopped seeing any results in what they set out to achieve.

You will benefit from having someone to be accountable to and help you’re training by teaching you the correct techniques for exercises and understand nutrition and how to apply it.
included_content:
- Receive a personalised nutrition plan while trying to keep your lifestyle in mind all while increasing your nutrition knowledge and promoting healthy eating habits.

- Nutrition plan adjustments because these will be essential as your progress will slow down the more body fat you drop.

- Training plan designed relative to your goal and starting place to help you gain more confidence and experience in the gym while boosting activity outside the gym.

- Training plan adjustments for continued progress by breaking plateaus.

- Regular tracking and reviews of progress with feedback and actions for weeks ahead.

- Photos, scales and how you feel will be used to measure progress.
results_content:
If you are willing to commit 100% to the process by working hard, staying consistent, remaining patient, and acting on feedback then you will achieve results whatever your age, ability and starting point.

I will deliver improvements across the board in your weight, body fat, body tone, posture, physical strength and fitness, and performance. You will also feel the difference in measures such as mood, stress, sleep, digestion, confidence, and energy.
investment_content:
Have a real return on your investment because I’m invested in you achieving your goal. Receive help over every hurdle while gaining the knowledge of how to avoid them in future.

Sessions will be 60 minutes long in which I will show you how to safely use a variety of gym equipment, helping you reduce your dependency in the gym.

Benefit as many before you by beginning your results driven programme which includes a structure of accountability to keep you on track with the option to extend your programme.

Find out more by [booking](/booking#book) a complementary consultation today.

title: 2:1 Personal Training
introduction:
Share all the benefits of one to one personal training. 
 Fun fact, studies have shown that exercising with a friend or family member can increase calories burned by up to 25%.
audience_content:
If you have a common health and fitness related goal and can workout at the same time, then this is a great way to share the experience of personal training and achieve your goals in a faster time frame.

Whether you both have the same experience in the gym or not, you'll still be individually supported to reach your respective goals as you train together.

You are less likely to quit the process early or put less effort into your workouts as their will be a little friendly competition to each session.

results_content:
If you are both willing to commit 100% to the process by working hard, staying consistent, remaining patient, asking questions, and applying feedback then you will both achieve results whatever your age, ability or starting point.

I will deliver improvements across the board in your weight, body fat, body tone, posture, physical strength and fitness, and performance. You will also feel the difference in measures such as mood, stress, sleep, digestion, confidence, and energy.

Minimise the cost by splitting the payments between yourselves and have a real return on your investment because I’m invested in you achieving your goals. Receive help over every hurdle and gain the knowledge of how to avoid them in future.

title: Health Check
introduction:
Health Check tailored just for you.

Health check to help to highlight what symptoms and habits are holding you back from reaching your goals and what you could do today to begin positively managing your health.
audience_content: This is perfect for someone who would like to lower their high blood sugar, cholesterol, blood pressure and or someone who’s hit a plateau in their training and Weight loss goal.
